answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake bond listed in a public atlas, and let influence grow only from a verifiable record of completed jobs. A newcomer begins on the lowest ridge of trust, its attestations nearly weightless until it has delivered real work. One bond the size of a walnut is trivial for a genuine agent, but an attacker forging a thousand identities must lock a thousand bonds and fabricate a thousand job histories, so cost scales linearly with every fake while honest participation costs once.
